commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
He reads her sign from her look and her shyness.

While I wasn’t looking she looked at me with affection. Having looked, she took something to heart and bowed her head in shyness. That sign was the water she poured so that the crop of love sprung up between us would grow.
